title: Toward Machine-Learning-Accelerated Design of All-Dielectric Magnetophotonic Nanostructures
summary: The full primary article uses neural-network and polynomial-regression models trained on 12,170 simulated magnetophotonic grating configurations to predict transverse magneto-optical Kerr response and resonance. Validation against 3,043 held-out full-wave simulations and a previously unseen grating design supports accelerated design of an all-dielectric biosensing nanostructure; predicted performance remains simulation-based and within the training parameter range.
ai_technology: Neural network and polynomial regression models map grating geometry and wavelength to simulated TMOKE amplitude/resonance for rapid design.
